copy.c320: Career Studio grew out of the CareerBot hackathon project. This full-cycle portfolio project uses React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker and CI. AI features require server provider configuration.

copy.c364: Data processing in the current service version · October 4, 2026
copy.c366: Accounts, profiles, structured resumes and versions, vacancies, companies, interviews, learning plans and progress events are stored in PostgreSQL. Passwords are hashed. Sessions and request limits are stored in Redis.
copy.c367: Uploaded files are used for extraction and are not kept as separate attachments. Downloaded PDF and Word files are generated from saved fields.
copy.c369: When you use AI, the selected OpenAI or Google provider receives the data needed for the task: resumes, selected profile fields, vacancy descriptions or answers. Do not upload information you do not want to share with that provider.
copy.c370: AI responses may contain errors. Check dates, wording and facts before sending a resume to an employer. Practice scores are not professional suitability assessments or employment guarantees.
copy.c371: Full voice interviews use OpenAI. The microphone starts only when you activate it. The service saves a transcript and evaluation, not audio recordings. Provider processing follows its own terms.
copy.c372: Text-interview dictation uses browser speech recognition; its provider may process audio. You can edit the recognized text before sending it.
copy.c374: Added skills and descriptions are visible to other users. Do not include personal information. Administrators publish knowledge articles; drafts are hidden from regular users.
copy.c376: Signing out ends the session and keeps your materials. Download personal data as JSON in Settings. Password accounts can be deleted after confirming email and current password: profiles, resumes, vacancies, interviews, plans and activity are removed from the working database. Shared skills and published articles remain. Google-account deletion currently requires the operator. AI-provider copies and operator backups follow their separate retention policies. Password changes invalidate all old sessions.
